import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert 'is_fraud' to a more descriptive categorical type for plotting
df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraudulent', 1: 'Fraudulent'})

# Set a clean style for the plots
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')

# Create a figure with 3 subplots to display different insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 18))

# --- Subplot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status ---
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis', linewidth=2)
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right', frameon=True)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=10)


# --- Subplot 2: Fraud Rate by Transaction Type ---
# Calculate the fraud rate (mean of 'is_fraud') for each transaction type
fraud_rate_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=fraud_rate_by_type.sort_values(by='is_fraud', ascending=False),
            x='transaction_type', y='is_fraud', ax=axes[1], palette='plasma')
axes[1].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (Proportion)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=10) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
axes[1].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[1].set_ylim(0, fraud_rate_by_type['is_fraud'].max() * 1.1) # Set y-limit for better visualization

# --- Subplot 3: Fraud Rate by Hour of Day ---
# Calculate the fraud rate for each hour of the day
fraud_rate_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean().reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=fraud_rate_by_hour, x='hour_of_day', y='is_fraud', ax=axes[2], palette='cividis')
axes[2].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (Proportion)', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Show ticks for every other hour for clarity
axes[2].tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=10)
axes[2].set_ylim(0, fraud_rate_by_hour['is_fraud'].max() * 1.1) # Set y-limit for better visualization


plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98]) # Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles/labels, leaving space for a potential suptitle
plt.suptitle('Insights into Credit Card Fraud Patterns', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=1.02) # Overall title

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
